method.events: Same limb+hold, one-to-one; visible IoU uses interval unions after masking occlusions. Entirely hidden units excluded from both denominators.
method.event_delay: Allow each matched prediction to be backdated by up to delta at 1/source-fps resolution. This is a tolerant evaluator, not a learned delay correction.
method.frames: One fixed backdating delta for all predictions. Exclude occlusion at original and aligned time, unscorable labels and out-of-video times. Unknown remains FN on visible ground-truth contacts.
method.any_overlap: Positive overlap suffices to count a contact occurrence; does not certify its duration.
method.identity_only: Deliberately optimistic bound: correct limb and hold anywhere in video. Not an acceptable timed-contact metric.
method.unique_pair: Visible evidence only, ignore all timing and collapse repeated limb/hold pairs. Unmapped automatic IDs remain distinct false positives.
limitations: Occlusion annotated only during labelled contacts
No joint-coordinate or pixel-mask ground truth
Frame scores use raw candidates, event scores use filtered contacts
